play: Delivery capacity for the global engineering hubs
thesis: Chevron is taking out $3-4B of structural cost by end-2026 and cutting 15-20% of its workforce. At the same time it is integrating Hess, moving engineering to Houston and the ~$1B ENGINE center in Bengaluru, and moving IT support to Manila and Buenos Aires. It already uses Copilot and Claude and is building agentic AI on Azure. Devin is the execution layer for the hubs: autonomous engineers that work Hess integration, backlog and code-security work through governed, human-approved pull requests.

why_now.t: The cost target lands end-2026. Productivity through technology and global centers is the stated mechanism.
Leadership reshuffle on Jan 1, 2027: a new CFO (Gustavson) and Brent Gros taking over AI strategy. New owners will re-set the agenda.
ENGINE Bengaluru is staffing 1,000+ engineers now. Patterns set in the first year stick.
Hess systems integration is still under way after the synergy target was hit.

challenges.stated: Structural cost reduction: $1.5B achieved in 2025, target raised to $3-4B by end-2026.
challenges.devin: Engineering capacity without headcount, measured in contractor and SI hours avoided.

challenges.stated: Cut 15-20% of the workforce, move to global hubs, and consolidate IT support into Manila and Buenos Aires.
challenges.devin: DeepWiki and Knowledge capture what the departing teams know. Devin keeps the maintenance backlog flat as people move.

challenges.stated: 'Leveraging technology to enhance productivity' and 'expanded use of global centers'.
challenges.devin: Use Chevron's own wording in the opener. Devin is the technology lever that gives the hubs more output.

challenges.stated: Copilot and Claude are already enterprise tools, and Enterprise AI is hiring to build agentic systems on Azure.
challenges.devin: Assistants help one engineer at a time. Devin takes a whole ticket from start to finished PR, in parallel, and fits beside Copilot.

challenges.stated: Cyber threats to operational technology and digital infrastructure from state actors; runs a Cyber Intelligence Center.
challenges.devin: Security Swarm and Code Scans for vulnerability backlog, in isolated machines with an audit trail.

challenges.stated: A Responsible AI Institute member that assesses each AI system's readiness and limitations.
challenges.devin: Bring governance evidence first: a human approves every PR, every session is recorded, access is scoped.

pain_chain.pain: $3-4B structural cost and Hess synergies are promised to the market.
The same delivery commitments with 15-20% fewer people, spread over new hubs.
pain_chain.measure: Project delivery dates; IT cost per user; vulnerabilities open

pain_chain.pain: Onboarding thousands of engineers while legacy and Hess backlogs keep growing.
pain_chain.measure: Backlog age; cycle time; knowledge-transfer completeness

pain_chain.pain: Upgrades, test coverage and security fixes crowd out feature work.
pain_chain.measure: Tickets per sprint; PR review time

com.elevator: You're delivering $3-4B of structural savings with fewer people, through Houston and Bengaluru. Devin gives each hub autonomous engineers that finish Hess integration, upgrades and security tickets end-to-end, as tested, recorded pull requests your engineers approve.
before: Backlog grows as roles move to hubs
Copilot and Claude help individuals, but whole tickets still need a person
Hess integration and app rationalization compete for the same engineers
Cyber findings on the OT and IT boundary wait in queues
negative: Cost-out arrives late or turns into SI spend
Knowledge is lost in the move from San Ramon and the regions
Security debt keeps building on critical infrastructure
after: Each hub team runs parallel Devins on a defined backlog
Hess app retirement and migration done on a dated plan
Vulnerability time-to-fix falls with a full audit trail
A governed agent pattern that Enterprise AI can reuse across the company
required: A human approves every merge, and every session is recorded
Runs in isolated machines inside approved boundaries
Output is measured against a baseline
metrics: Backlog tickets closed per hub per month
Mean time to close critical vulnerabilities
proof: Tell them we complement Copilot and Claude
